subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: After the timeout-plumbing defect is repaired, does the gateway owner require redacted live WeChat account A+B QR-login evidence before merge, or accept the focused gateway lifecycle regressions as sufficient for this provider-backed handoff?
rationale: The contributor has accurately documented that their environment cannot run the provider session; choosing the acceptable proof threshold is a gateway-owner validation policy decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup attaches redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B is added.

options.title: Waive provider proof explicitly
options.body: Accept focused gateway lifecycle coverage after the timeout repair if the gateway owner concludes that it adequately proves this manager-owned handoff.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup attaches redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely routing contact from the initial gateway-area discussion; ownership evidence is limited.
